#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;int main(){int m,n;cin>>m>>n;vector<string>g(m);for(auto&x:g)cin>>x;int ans=0,dx[]={1,-1,0,0},dy[]={0,0,1,-1};for(int i=0;i<m;i++)for(int j=0;j<n;j++)if(g[i][j]=='1'){ans++;queue<pair<int,int>>q;q.push({i,j});g[i][j]='0';while(!q.empty()){auto [x,y]=q.front();q.pop();for(int k=0;k<4;k++){int a=x+dx[k],b=y+dy[k];if(a>=0&&a<m&&b>=0&&b<n&&g[a][b]=='1'){g[a][b]='0';q.push({a,b});}}}}cout<<ans;}

const t=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/),m=+t[0],n=+t[1],g=t.slice(2).map(x=>x.split(''));let ans=0;for(let i=0;i<m;i++)for(let j=0;j<n;j++)if(g[i][j]==='1'){ans++;let q=[[i,j]];g[i][j]='0';for(let h=0;h<q.length;h++){let [x,y]=q[h];for(const [a,b] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){let u=x+a,v=y+b;if(u>=0&&u<m&&v>=0&&v<n&&g[u][v]==='1'){g[u][v]='0';q.push([u,v])}}}}console.log(ans);

using namespace std;int main(){int q;cin>>q;stack<int>a,b;while(q--){string op;cin>>op;if(op=="push"){int x;cin>>x;a.push(x);}else{if(b.empty())while(!a.empty()){b.push(a.top());a.pop();}cout<<b.top()<<"\n";if(op=="pop")b.pop();}}}

import java.util.*;public class Main{public static void main(String[]z){Scanner s=new Scanner(System.in);int q=s.nextInt();Deque<Integer>a=new ArrayDeque<>(),b=new ArrayDeque<>();StringBuilder o=new StringBuilder();while(q-->0){String op=s.next();if(op.equals("push"))a.push(s.nextInt());else{if(b.isEmpty())while(!a.isEmpty())b.push(a.pop());o.append(b.peek()).append('\n');if(op.equals("pop"))b.pop();}}System.out.print(o);}}

const t=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/);let i=0,q=+t[i++],a=[],b=[],o=[];while(q--){let op=t[i++];if(op==='push')a.push(+t[i++]);else{if(!b.length)b=a.reverse(),a=[];o.push(b[b.length-1]);if(op==='pop')b.pop()}}console.log(o.join('\n'));
